💡 beautiful-mermaid | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide developers with a fast, customizable, and versatile library for rendering text-based diagrams (Mermaid) into both graphical (SVG) and terminal-friendly (ASCII) formats, enhancing visualization in various environments.
✨ Key Features: • Supports 6 diagram types (Flowcharts, State, Sequence, Class, ER, XY Charts) • Dual output: SVG for UIs, ASCII/Unicode for terminals • Synchronous rendering for immediate output • 15 built-in themes and easy custom theme creation
📖 Summary: Beautiful-mermaid is a TypeScript library that renders Mermaid diagrams into visually appealing SVGs or ASCII art. It offers ultra-fast, themeable diagram generation with zero DOM dependencies, making it suitable for both rich UIs and terminal environments.
